import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import ref, main as M
rnd = random.Random(0)
nn = 12
chain = list(range(10, 10 + nn*7, 7))
w = 5
rib=[]
for s in range(0, max(1, nn-w+1)):
    seg = chain[s:s+w]
    rib.append({'path': list(seg), 'count': 1})
agg = {}
for rec in rib:
    p = ref.normalize(rec['path'], set())
    agg[tuple(p)] = agg.get(tuple(p),0)+rec['count']
final, rounds = ref.ref_peel(agg)
print("final paths:", len(final), "rounds:", rounds)
core = set()
for p in final:
    for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
print("core links:", len(core))
occs = ref.ref_occurrences(final)
adj = ref.scope_graph(occs, core)
print("degrees:", {ref.canon(*[k]): len(v) for k,v in adj.items()})
order = ref.find_order(adj)
print("order:", order)
EOF
